Product

Sicharge D - Charging Center

MP / P6 170000697
Charger ID
: TmguWp
Problem Description
: Activation of screensaver
Upon reviewing the system, we have confirmed that the screensaver pack has already been successfully activated on both chargers, including unit YrLp98.
Could you please check the displays on your end to confirm they are appearing as expected? If the error flag persists or the screensavers are not visible, please let us know so we can investigate further.
For your reference, this support request has been assigned the following case number:
0469028
, please include this number in any future correspondence regarding this issue.
We appreciate the details you have shared so far. We are currently reviewing your case and will provide you with an update or next steps.
We want to inform you that our average turnaround time is longer than expected, currently 7 days.
If we can make it sooner, we will inform you in a timely manner.
Thank you in advance for your understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Jagmeet Singh
